source_inventory.scope: AST import statements, including function-local imports; dynamic imports and external dependency internals not certified

completion_source_recheck.scope: cached bytes and recorded Git blob identity; no remote refresh or GPU execution

capacity.scope: source-derived limits and conditional demand; not measured active connections or full modern wire layout

saved_receipts.scope: saved versioned summaries only; tests/networks not rerun by this audit

illustrative_frequency_model.scope: hypothetical mean latency if all paired fault excess vanished with zero normal overhead; not an achievable bound, production rate, or SR result
